Qt notice for Bimeron Desktop Windows packages

Bimeron Desktop for Windows includes unmodified dynamic libraries and plugins of
the Qt framework, version 6.8.3, deployed by windeployqt (for example
Qt6Core.dll, Qt6Gui.dll, Qt6Network.dll, Qt6Svg.dll, Qt6Widgets.dll and the
platform, style, image format and TLS plugins).

Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors.

Qt is used under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3 (LGPL-3.0).
The license text is in LGPL-3.0.txt; it incorporates the GNU General Public
License version 3, whose text is in GPL-3.0.txt.

Bimeron Desktop links Qt dynamically. You may replace the Qt libraries in the
installation directory with your own compatible, modified builds of Qt 6.8.3.

The complete corresponding source code of Qt 6.8.3 is available from
https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.8/6.8.3/single/ and
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/ (tag v6.8.3). The Qt libraries in this package were
not modified.

Qt itself contains third-party components (for example zlib, libpng,
FreeType, HarfBuzz, PCRE2 and libjpeg) under their own licenses. Their
attributions and license texts are listed at
https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.8/licenses-used-in-qt.html and in the Qt source code.

Linux packages do not include Qt; they use the Qt libraries provided by the
operating system.
